Question: The sales tax rate in Bergville is \(6\%\). During a sale at the Bergville Coat Closet, the price of a coat is discounted \(20\%\) from its \(\$90.00\) price. Two clerks, Jack and Jill, calculate the bill independently. Jack rings up \(\$90.00\) and adds \(6\%\) sales tax, then subtracts \(20\%\) from this total. Jill rings up \(\$90.00\), subtracts \(20\%\) of the price, then adds \(6\%\) of the discounted price for sales tax. What is Jack’s total minus Jill’s total?
